svg.title: G06 Wind a coil
svg.text: G06 Wind one coil: 28 turns, 4 wires side by side (chuck NP1-T04)
Every coil is wound the same way. Reversing happens later, when connecting (G09).
Clamp the segment on the chuck.
Leave 150 mm start lead at the
rear end. Put a red tag on it
Tie the coil ends with glass tape,
fit the separator on each side
Layer plan: lay the wires in this order, one layer at a time, starting next to the tooth
TOOTH (seen end-on, cut through the coil side)
dashed line = half-slot edge (separator): wires must stay above it
